Contribution.text: Mbed TLS implements TLS, DTLS protocols and X.509 certificate manipulation. The [`development`](https://github.com/Mbed-TLS/mbedtls/tree/development) branch: this is where the next minor version of Mbed TLS 4.x is prepared. It contains new features, bug fixes, and security fixes. One or more long-time support (LTS) branches: these only get bug fixes and security fixes. Currently, the supported LTS branches are: - [`mbedtls-3.6`](https://github.com/Mbed-TLS/mbedtls/tree/mbedtls-3.6). - [`mbedtls-4.1`](https://github.com/Mbed-TLS/mbedtls/tree/mbedtls-4.1). research.summary: An open source, portable TLS library implementing TLS, DTLS and X.509 certificate manipulation.
research.notes: Tier: researched. Releases are modeled as branch-scoped series instead of duplicating every patch tag. The 2.0-2.27 row groups the historical 2.0 through 2.27 minor feature lines, including the archived 2.7 and 2.16 LTS lines; those archived lines have no stated terminal date, so their lifecycle milestones remain unknown. Its GA is the first stable 2.x release. The 3.0-3.5 row likewise groups historical feature lines 3.0 through 3.5, with GA marking 3.0.0. The 2.28 initial promise of support through the end of 2024 is superseded by the explicitly terminal 2.28.10 release: eossec and eol 2025-03-24 are derived by release-trigger from that release and are not vendor-stated milestone dates. The 3.6 and 4.1 support deadlines retain the source's month precision and the qualifier 'at least'. The development branch prepares an unreleased next 4.x minor and is not a lifecycle release. PolarSSL predecessor releases, beta/RC builds, packaging aliases, security advisories, and release cadence are excluded.
